insights.one_liner: GetYourGuide is a Berlin-based online marketplace for booking tours and activities, with a manager-level sales job in Amsterdam that doesn't need Dutch.

culture.text: About 1,536 people on LinkedIn; many studied computer science, business or economics at ETH Zürich, TU Berlin, Berlin School of Economics and Law or LSE.
A travel-tech company: travellers book from 200,000 experiences in more than 18,000 cities, offered by 50,000+ partners.
Its one open role here is a manager-level sales job in Amsterdam.

open.text: Not on the IND list of recognised visa sponsors.
Its one open job here does not require Dutch.

growth.text: Had about 1,000 staff in 2019; LinkedIn now shows about 1,536.
Reached profit after a sixteen-year road, according to a feature on the company.

worth_knowing.text: Dutch travel group Prijsvrij D-reizen ended its partnership with GetYourGuide over concerns about animal welfare in wildlife activities.
Warns about scammers posing as its recruiters; real jobs are only posted on its own careers page and it never asks for payment.
